patterns.note: Asymmetrical hero section featuring a large, custom-illustrated logotype dynamically overlaying a vibrant, art-directed photograph, creating a visually rich and unique brand introduction.

Distinctive use of a highly stylized, organic display font for the main brand identity, contrasted with a clean, modern sans-serif for body text and functional elements, creating a playful yet legible hierarchy.
A rich, warm, and earthy primary palette (browns, creams, purples) is consistently accented by vibrant, natural food colors within the photography and subtle UI elements.
The hero section's main image and large logotype subtly scale down and parallax as the user scrolls, with the logotype smoothly transitioning into a sticky header element at the top of the viewport.

A repeating, full-width banner with bold, uppercase text ('IMPORTANT MEAL OF THE DAY') acts as a thematic divider and visual anchor between distinct content blocks, reinforcing the site's core message.

technique_notes: The hero section features a large, custom-drawn logotype positioned over a full-bleed, high-quality photograph. As the user scrolls, the logotype scales down and transitions into a sticky header, while the background image subtly parallaxes and scales, creating a dynamic scroll experience using GSAP.
Content sections below the hero are revealed with a subtle slide-up or fade-in animation as they enter the viewport, creating a smooth flow down the page.

A fixed-position navigation bar at the top of the page transforms from a transparent state with minimal branding to a solid background with a prominent logo and navigation links after initial scroll, providing persistent access to navigation.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, organic display font for the brand name (~4x body) with clean, modern sans-serif headings (~2x body) and smaller, legible body text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners on buttons and image cards, with some elements having sharp edges.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced spacing throughout, with an airy hero section and a more dense, but still readable, feature grid.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a custom, organic display typeface for its brand identity, combined with art-directed, slightly surreal photography, creates a unique editorial and playful aesthetic that stands apart from typical marketing sites. The seamless transition of the hero logotype into a sticky header is a particularly elegant touch that enhances brand recall.
